decisions.reason: A low-cost accessory that complements the core trailer range and uses little production capacity, so it hardly counts against the aspiration level and there is no reason to search for other uses of its resources.
Featured on the home page in both observed years, this box trailer line is central to the core business and appears to meet aspirations, so it is kept.
Car transporters are a niche but steady professional segment that fits the firm's know-how, and absent evidence of a shortfall the firm's slack allows it to carry the line.
This home-page low-bed series is a core volume product line consistent with the firm's strategy, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
High-cover trailers are a staple of the firm's range and were prominently promoted, which suggests performance at or above aspiration.
This second box trailer series overlaps with B and may later be consolidated, but its home-page prominence indicates continued commitment.
